player_identity.semantics: parser-side player identity and raw team, without faction or strategic interpretation

player_death.semantics: factual death observation only; killer, assists, fights, and cause are not promoted

player_respawn.semantics: parser-time return observation or deterministic inference, not official respawn timer

raw_objective_structure_lifecycle.semantics: raw lifecycle/health/state observation transformed to neutral canonical category without objective completion semantics

identityRules.entityKey: neutral canonical key derived from replay id, class name, and raw handle; legacy spatial identifiers are provenance only
identityRules.entityIndex: null unless source explicitly provides a decoded index
identityRules.entitySerial: null unless source explicitly provides serial
identityRules.entityGeneration: null unless lifecycle evidence supports a generation
